name: naabu
title: Naabu
description: Fast SYN/CONNECT port scanner from ProjectDiscovery. Set NAABU_HOST (or NAABU_HOST_LIST) and either NAABU_PORTS (explicit list/ranges, e.g. '22,80,443,8000-8100') OR NAABU_TOP_PORTS — valid values: 100 | 1000 | full. NAABU_PORTS and NAABU_TOP_PORTS are mutually exclusive; pass only one. Use NAABU_RATE (packets/sec) and NAABU_THREADS to tune speed. Network scanning is prohibited on the AWS-hosted agent — only run naabu on the DigitalOcean droplet.
